Syllabus


Train the Trainer


Design, develop and deliver training based on research-driven educational principles.






Abstract


This course offers guidance, ideas and tips for designing, developing and delivering training, all based on research-driven educational principles. It covers learning principles and how they apply to training and teaching; designing and planning sessions, courses and materials; teaching techniques that enhance learner engagement and participation; assessment and feedback; and creating and maintaining engagement. The course is highly interactive, so it is important that you, as a participant, actively contribute to all sessions.


Keywords: Train the Trainer · teaching · training · instructional design · learner engagement · assessment · feedback




Details




Dates


10 Apr 2024 – 02 May 2024




Duration


Four half days




Delivery


Online




Location


Online




Language


English






Learning outcomes


After completing this training, participants will be able to:



Name learning principles that a good teacher or instructor should have in mind


Describe at least three training techniques, drawing on learning principles


Design a training session and a course


Develop assessment questionnaires


Enumerate types of materials needed for each part of a training session or course


Describe strategies to promote engagement amongst learners





Target audience


Anyone who is interested in becoming a trainer or instructor, or in improving their training skills.




Forms of instruction and examination




Forms of instruction



Interactive online sessions over Zoom


Course pages in Canvas

FAQ


Frequently asked questions


Answers to common questions about Train the Trainer.





1.Is this course for me?



The course is for anyone who is interested in becoming a trainer or instructor, or in improving their training skills. It may be very helpful to you if you have questions like these: How does learning work? How do I make my teaching more engaging and effective? How should I adjust my teaching to different types of learners? How can I assess whether learning is happening? What is the best balance between theory and practice?





2.Does the course cost anything?



No, there are no fees for this course.





3.How many participants can attend?



A maximum of 25. If there are more applications, priority is given to applicants from SciLifeLab infrastructures, institutes and organisations across the Nordic research community, and to participants from Nordic ELIXIR nodes.





4.How is the course delivered?



The course is delivered online over Zoom, with the course pages in Canvas, a learning management system. The course is highly interactive: please take an active part in all sessions.
